page.notes: Page is faint and stained at the lower edge; the last line and catchword are cut off and only partly legible. The left-margin notes "Calor pre" and "organum" are cut off or unclear, and their placement against the lines is approximate. Marginal note "organum" next to "humorum" was read as "coctionis" and "cipuum" next to "commodiffime"; the marginal words are not fully reliable. The word after "dos" and the word "qnod" are doubtful.
